_comment: Quest dungeon doors per ACG style. DoorTemplate / ExitTemplate are door item templates (StaticInstance; the template's Flags stat is the door's base flags), from captured live dungeons: 321 office, 324 clan, 341 mine/wild cave, 351. Doors are rolled from the dungeon seed: the exit always spawns open; interior doors spawn locked (flag 0x40) or open (0x80) by these chances. Live captures show about 15% of interior doors open and about 2% locked; locked stays 0 until lockpicking exists, since a locked door would block the dungeon.

Styles.Source: Interior doors: live alien ACG door template 253517 (items.dat Door, DynelType 51016, Flags 0xC0081003, Mesh 247861, Can 8, StateMachine 1), matching every interior door Randy captured in live alien ACG 14731349 on 2026-10-30 19:15 (scraper v5.6 doors_20261030_Nazgore_v6.csv). Live doors all spawn closed (no 0x80) and open/close by themselves as you walk through (about 1.3 s, no server packet), so OpenChancePercent is 0. The exit stays the blue mission Exit portal 303198 (mesh 44891) in the round entrance doorway. Before this, doorways were open archways (office doors looked wrong, Randy 2026-10-18 19:33).
